item.title: 2026 Cabrinha Moto Apex Kite
item.description: A new chapter. Rebuilt from the ground up, the Moto Apex Aluula pushes freeride performance to new heights. A high aspect design delivers greater efficiency, faster board speed, and increased hang time, giving the kite a lighter, faster, more responsive feel in the sky. Swept, narrower wingtips reduce drag and focus the canopy’s power toward the center, creating smoother acceleration and more efficient power delivery.
